ngaap.items_eps_impact_wording: For the year ended December 31, 2006, the impact of these items, excluding the Pratt & Whitney gain of $25 million on the sale of a partnership interest ($.18 per share) was offset by pre-tax restructuring and related charges ($.19 per share) resulting in a net $.01 adverse impact to earnings per share.
ngaap.guidance: We believe we are well positioned for earnings increases in 2007 and especially on favorable compares at Carrier and Sikorsky. We confirm prior guidance for 2007 earnings per share in the $4.05 to $4.20 range and cash flow after capital expenditures again to exceed net income. ... Additional favorable items are anticipated in 2007 to offset trailing costs from previous restructuring actions as well as to fund potential new actions initiated throughout the year.
ngaap.definitions: No adjusted EPS or adjusted operating profit is published. The release tabulates "Restructuring and Related Charges" by segment and lists "non-recurring items" in bullet text. Organic growth: "the total reported revenue increase within the Corporation's ongoing businesses less the impact of foreign currency translation, acquisitions and divestitures completed in the preceding twelve months and significant non-recurring items." EPS growth references are "before the cumulative effect of a change in accounting" (FIN 47, 2005).

notes: Annual record: IS, BS and CF from the FY2006 10-K Exhibit 13 (agree with the Q4-06 release twelve-month column); segment and restructuring tables from the release. Revenues (47,829) include "Financing revenues and other income, net" (711), so is.sales = revenues as presented and other_income is null (kept in other_income_in_revenues); sales_products + sales_services = 47,118, so the validator check "sales = products + services" fails by 711 by construction. IS: shares 980.0 / 1,005.7 from the 10-K EPS note (release prints 980 / 1,006). No adjusted figures are published. BS: other_ca 1,962 = Future income tax benefits 1,261 + Other current assets 701; other_nca 4,137 = Future income tax benefits 1,690 + Other assets 2,447; common_stock 9,395 = Common Stock 9,622 less Unearned ESOP shares (227) (as the release nets them); bs.nci = minority interests in subsidiary companies 836 (mezzanine, outside equity), te not presented. CF: other_op 71 = Minority interests in subsidiaries’ earnings 266 + Other, net (195); customer_financing 68 = (314) + 382; other_fin 210 = Common Stock issued under employee stock plans 346 + Dividends to minority interests and other (136).
